title: Voice
about: One or two sentences about the person and how their work runs.

workers.name: Control
workers.use: Plans, agents, PRs, deploys and getting things done

workers.name: plan lead
workers.use: One plan's detail; needs the plan number
workers.handoff: I'll check with that plan's lead

sources.name: focus list
sources.use: The decision-maker's current focus list and priorities

hearing: Plan numbers are like ABC-123; "ABC one two three" is ABC-123.

asks._note: Optional. Both commands set turns on answer_ask. listCommand prints asks.json; answerCommand reads {"argv": ["board", "answered", ...]} as JSON on stdin and runs it. dryRun logs the write instead of running it.

chief._note: Optional. worker names one of the workers above (a session found by seat or title): set it to turn on chief-of-staff mode (set_mode, note_to_chief), where the person's words go to that session verbatim. dryRun (or SIFT_CHIEF_DRY_RUN=1) logs each message instead of sending it.
chief.label: Chief of staff

memory._note: Optional. dir turns on call notes and recall; dejaCommand reads the query on stdin.

reader._note: Optional. Turns on Sift's own read-only reading (plan, plan_search, github, vault, server_status, web) and look_into, a short background read on a cheap model. Every part is off unless its key is set. The God session folder is never readable.

_note_preload: preload: read the needs queue, sessions, sources marked preload and recent call notes at call start (and offer catch_up). filler: say a short line when a tool starts in silence.
